UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public Chatbox user lookup profile containing UID and display name (no PII/email).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

UserBlock.title: UserBlock
UserBlock.description: Owner-private block entry blocking a peer UID from initiating or continuing interactions.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Direct two-participant conversation with consent status lifecycle (pending -> active/closed).

createdBy.description: UID of the user who initiated the conversation request.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Immutable direct message inside a conversation (text, attached image, and/or Firebase Storage voice note).

body.description: Message text content (0..2000 chars; required non-empty when imageUrl and audioUrl are absent).

imageUrl.description: Optional Firebase Storage HTTPS download URL for an attached image.

audioUrl.description: Optional Firebase Storage HTTPS download URL for a recorded voice note.

audioDurationMs.description: Optional duration in milliseconds for the attached voice note (0..300000).

SparkAdmin.title: SparkAdmin
SparkAdmin.description: Single owner registration record for Spark Admin Studio.

SparkDelegation.title: SparkDelegation
SparkDelegation.description: Delegated Spark Admin invitation/status keyed by verified Gmail address.

uid.description: Delegate UID once accepted, or empty string when invited.

invitedBy.description: Owner UID who issued the invitation.

SparkPublicWelcome.title: SparkPublicWelcome
SparkPublicWelcome.description: Public welcome message configured by Spark Admin.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin/delegate who updated the welcome text.

SparkAppearanceSetting.title: SparkAppearanceSetting
SparkAppearanceSetting.description: Bounded public appearance setting (sparkTheme or sparkMenu).

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin/delegate who updated the setting.

SparkAppUpdate.title: SparkAppUpdate
SparkAppUpdate.description: App update notice published from Spark Admin or backend so users see a green update badge next to the logo.

active.description: Whether an update notice is currently active.

version.description: Target app version string (1..32 chars when active).

note.description: Short summary of what is new (0..240 chars).

downloadUrl.description: Optional HTTPS release or store link (0..512 chars).

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin/delegate who published the update notice.

UserFcmDevice.title: UserFcmDevice
UserFcmDevice.description: Owner-private Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token for push notifications on an Android device.

SairaChatSession.title: SairaChatSession
SairaChatSession.description: Owner-private saved Saira Assistant conversation session header so users can browse and resume past chats.

title.description: Session title derived from the opening prompt (1..120 chars).

lastPreview.description: Short preview of the latest reply or exchange (0..240 chars).

exchangeCount.description: Number of completed Q&A exchanges in this session (0..5000).

SairaSessionExchange.title: SairaSessionExchange
SairaSessionExchange.description: Immutable saved prompt-and-reply exchange inside a user's Saira Assistant chat session.

sequence.description: Zero-based exchange order index within the session (0..100000).

/profiles/{uid}.description: Direct UID lookup profile for starting live conversations.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Messages belonging to a direct conversation.

/users/{userId}/sairaSessions/{sessionId.description: Owner-private saved Saira Assistant conversation sessions.
Ordered prompt-and-response exchanges inside a saved Saira Assistant session.

/settings/sparkPublic.description: Public welcome message managed by Spark Admin.

/settings/sparkUpdate.description: App update notice observed by signed-in clients.

/userFcmTokens/{ownerId}/devices/{device.description: Owner-private FCM device tokens used by backend push dispatchers.
